auto;gap:8px;margin-top:14px}.button{padding:10px 13px;border:1px solid Customer success

Renewal risk review

Weekly account meeting · 3 accounts to review

Review queue

3

Account AC-903

Northstar Labs

Renewal risk review before the account planning meeting

Renewal risk: elevated
PlanEnterprise annual
Contract value$84K ARR
Primary riskChampion change

Usage trend

−28%across two reporting periods
EarlierPreviousLatest

Risk evidence

  • Usage dropped 28 percent over the last two reporting periods.
  • Primary champion left the account last month.
  • Evidence gap: procurement timeline is missing before escalation.

Decision guidance

Executive escalation is appropriate when sponsor risk and renewal timing are clear. Resolve missing procurement dates before committing a save plan.

Choose next step

Record the decision and create a renewal handoff with one accountable owner.

Evidence gap: Procurement dates and renewal timing are not confirmed.
